scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing between a Puma Speedcat ballerina profile and an Adidas Samba, [X] compares how each design works with jeans, skirts, and trousers across retro familiarity, trend saturation, low-profile shape, subcultural edge, everyday versatility, and thin-sole comfort before narrowing the choice without yet making a purchase.
examples: using Vintage or Casual when the familiar retro model and broad wardrobe compatibility matter most
using Punk/Gothic only for the source-grounded indie-sleaze or niche edge, not for an invented dark color
keeping the decision at category level because the user never reports buying either model
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在 Puma Speedcat 芭蕾鞋型与 Adidas Samba 之间犹豫时，[X]会比较两种设计如何搭配牛仔裤、裙子和长裤，并权衡复古熟悉感、潮流饱和度、低帮轮廓、亚文化锐度、日常通用性和薄底舒适度，在尚未购买的情况下先收窄选择。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] coordinates shoes with an already chosen pink floral dress containing green and lavender, tests whether moderate strappy platforms can look formal and glamorous without overpowering the ruffled bodice, practices walking for the ceremony, and settles on that style alongside restrained jewelry.
examples: using Elegant when polish and ceremony formality dominate
using Cute when the feminine floral and delicate straps remain playful without becoming childish
tracking the selected strappy-platform direction through fit and walking practice rather than reopening an unrelated shoe category
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加毕业典礼时，[X]会给已选定且带绿色和薰衣草色的粉色花卉连衣裙搭配鞋子，检验中等高度的细带厚底鞋能否兼顾正式与华丽而不压过胸前褶饰，并为典礼练习行走，最终选定这一鞋履风格和克制的首饰。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After confirming a formal wedding dress code for an army-green suit, [X] compares the visual roles of brown, espresso, and black footwear, commits to black formal shoes, and carries that exact choice through the matching belt, socks, and neckwear rules of the final outfit.
examples: using Elegant for the committed formal role and polished finish
treating the selected black formal shoe as one traceable outfit component
not turning the later wedding role into a profession
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为军绿色西装确认婚礼为正式着装后，[X]会比较棕色、深咖色和黑色鞋履在视觉上的不同作用，随后确定黑色正装鞋，并让这项具体选择贯穿腰带、袜子和领饰的最终搭配规则。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an informal afternoon university reunion with no dress code, [X] repeatedly checks a sweater, dark jeans, and classic Crocs against walking, sitting, changing weather, and the wish to look recognizable rather than overdressed, using the event to define how relaxed the footwear role can be.
examples: using Casual when comfort, familiarity, and low social formality align
checking whether the same broad shoe direction survives the whole afternoon route
not claiming ownership of or repeated evidence from one identifiable pair
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加没有着装要求的大学下午聚会时，[X]会反复检验毛衣、深色牛仔裤和经典 Crocs 方向能否适应步行、久坐、天气变化以及不过度打扮但仍像自己的需求，由此确定鞋履风格可以休闲到什么程度。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing an unwanted owned pair for resale, [X] cleans it, photographs every side, and writes a factual listing, then classifies its visible silhouette, construction details, wear, and styling cues consistently so the title, category, photographs, and description do not promise a different aesthetic from the item shown.
examples: letting a later target supply the observed style of the actual photographed pair, including an uncommon Western or Bohemian direction when visible evidence supports it
separating Vintage from mere age and Punk/Gothic from mere dark color
keeping defects and condition factual rather than converting them into desirable style cues
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备转售不再需要的一双鞋时，[X]会先清洁、拍摄各个角度并撰写如实商品说明；随后根据照片中可见的轮廓、结构细节、磨损与造型线索统一判定风格，使标题、类目、照片和描述不会呈现彼此冲突的审美承诺。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a comfortable minimalist wardrobe around a white T-shirt, slim jeans, a denim jacket, and restrained accessories, [X] narrows the choice to simple black or white sneakers and checks whether the silhouette stays timeless, versatile, and understated across repeated outfits rather than merely following the latest trend.
examples: using Casual for easy daily coordination
using Elegant only when restraint and polish remain compatible with sneakers
keeping named models as examples because the user accepts a direction but does not report a purchase
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕白色 T 恤、修身牛仔裤、牛仔夹克和克制配饰建立舒适的极简衣橱时，[X]会把选择缩小到简洁的黑色或白色运动鞋，并检验轮廓能否在反复搭配中保持经典、通用和低调，而不是只追随最新潮流。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an Italian summer trip, [X] seeks footwear that is chic, comfortable, breathable, and available through sustainable sellers shipping locally; city cobblestones, heat, church visits, dinner polish, natural materials, and customs risk jointly narrow the style role before any pair is chosen.
examples: using Casual for breathable walking sneakers or easy sandals
using Elegant or Bohemian only when the later target remains compatible with long walking, Mediterranean heat, and the user's sustainability criterion
keeping retailer and model suggestions provisional because availability and purchase are not confirmed
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季行程寻找鞋履时，[X]要求它既雅致、舒适、透气，又能从可持续且向当地发货的商家购得；城市石板路、炎热天气、教堂参观、晚餐体面度、天然材料和关税风险共同收窄风格选择，但尚未选定具体鞋款。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a brown dress already owned and wide feet, [X] searches for white garden-wedding shoes that balance ceremony polish, a light romantic appearance, stable movement on soft ground, and enough toe room to avoid pinching without assuming that a photographed or purchased pair exists.
examples: using Elegant for wedding polish
using Cute or Bohemian when a lighter romantic or garden-oriented direction still satisfies width and stability
rejecting a visually suitable option if narrow construction or unstable footing undermines the actual event
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]已经拥有棕色连衣裙且脚掌较宽，需要为花园婚礼寻找白鞋，因此搜索会同时兼顾典礼体面、轻盈浪漫的外观、在松软地面上的稳定行走和不挤脚的鞋头空间，同时不假设已有照片或已经购买。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an Urban Jungle comic, [X] develops repeated character sheets in which footwear, costume materials, palette, and shape language distinguish a rounded village outsider, a poised city guide, and a faceless geometric threat, then preserves those shoe-design roles consistently across panels.
examples: using Cute or Bohemian for the rounded outsider only when wrapped footwear and natural patched materials remain coherent
using Elegant or Punk/Gothic for a poised angular figure or dark geometric threat without collapsing the characters into color labels
treating the footwear as a category-level fictional design, not as a real pair the user owns or wears
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为《Urban Jungle》漫画制作可反复使用的角色设定表时，[X]会让鞋履、服装材质、配色和形状语言区分圆润的村庄外来者、从容的城市向导和无面几何威胁，并在后续分镜中保持这些鞋履设计线索一致。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After asking broadly for women's shoes, [X] fixes three practical constraints: comfort, casual use, and a limited budget; the search compares sneakers, slip-ons, sandals, and familiar value brands by visual simplicity, everyday recognizability, support, local currency, and total purchase cost before choosing a style.
examples: using Casual for the user's stated everyday role
asking for location and currency before treating an advertised price as affordable
keeping style secondary to comfort and budget without erasing it from the final category choice
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 起初笼统询问女鞋推荐后，[X]会明确三个实际约束：舒适、日常休闲和有限预算；再在运动鞋、便鞋、凉鞋及常见平价品牌之间，比较视觉简洁度、日常熟悉感、支撑、当地货币和总购买成本，最后确定适合的风格。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A candidate interviewing for a managerial role at SAWEA builds a business-formal outfit whose shoes must project steady leadership rather than fashion novelty, comparing polished black and dark-brown dress-shoe directions against the suit, organization-facing meetings, conservative accessories, and the need to remain composed through the interview.
examples: using Elegant for the business-formal leadership signal
keeping the shoe at category level because no pair is selected or worn
counting the scene only as a professional extra because the managerial occupation is essential to the interaction
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名应聘 SAWEA 管理岗位的候选人准备商务正装，鞋履需要传达沉稳领导力而非追逐新奇潮流；他把抛光黑色与深棕色正装鞋方向放在西装、对外会议、克制配饰以及面试全程保持从容的需求中比较。
